meta.siteTitle: A Memory Album for My Friend
meta.occasion: A tiny archive of bright days
meta.intro: Collect the years, screenshots, trips, and quiet notes that make this friendship feel like home.
meta.footerText: Made with care, shared with consent.

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.description: A chaptered photo album about the friendship itself.

chapters.title: Chapter One: becoming familiar
chapters.summary: Describe the season when things started to feel natural. Keep it concrete: places, colors, weather, and habits.

photos.caption: The day we realized this was a real friendship
photos.reflection: Write what this photo means now. A good reflection tells the story behind the frame.

letter.title: A Letter for You
paragraphs: This is where the quiet part of the album lives. Say the things that are easier to write slowly.
Thank you for being part of my ordinary days, my loud days, and the days I did not know how to name.
